messages.subject: merging vectorized and master branches
parts:
I took Ben's advice and did a more careful merge -- that
kept everything Matt put in on the vectorized branch and a
few things I put into traits. It all compiles and runs OK now,
but the new normal implementation is NOT passing unit
tests yet. (So far, I fixed the zero-length vector issue and
am about to fix the prop-to calcs.)

Could everyone hold off on committing anything around the
traits and math/prob libs until I get a version passing unit
tests merged. I'll send out a note when I'm done.

Thanks.

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] finished merge of vectorized/master branches
parts:
On Jun 26, 2012, at 3:32 PM, Ben Goodrich wrote:

> Presumably you should now delete the vectorized branch both locally and on Google code with
>
> git branch -d vectorized
> git branch -d origin/vectorized

The first of these worked OK, the second says:

~/stan> git branch -d origin/vectorized
error: branch 'origin/vectorized' not found.

Turns out I needed:

~/stan> git push origin --delete vectorized
Password:
To https://carp%40alia...@code.google.com/p/stan/
- [deleted] vectorized

Gotta' love the indexing of StackOverflow.

- Bob
